title: External Blood Vessel
subtitle: A Wearable Wireless MIDI Instrument
summary: A wireless MIDI glove that turns hand gestures into notes, chords, drums and real-time musical control.
body: External Blood Vessel is a wearable wireless MIDI instrument designed to make electronic performance more physical and expressive. Distance, touch, rotation and motion sensors translate gestures—including swipes, wrist and elbow rotation, rapid downward movement and changes in hand spacing—into notes, chords, percussion and live mix parameters. The project combines a stable wireless system, calibrated sensor mappings and a custom microcontroller circuit with an organically shaped 3D-printed enclosure. Development progressed from exposed cardboard prototypes to a fully assembled instrument, followed by a live audiovisual performance used to evaluate responsiveness, range and playability.
